title: Retry an uncertain request without duplicating it
prompt:
A create-ticket call timed out with unknown outcome. The provider guarantees idempotent retries when the same idempotency key is reused. The original key is job-42. Choose the recovery request.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. action: retry_same_key, retry_new_key, or report_success; idempotency_key: string.
remediation_hints: Use the documented idempotency contract; an unknown outcome is not a confirmed failure.
